programme.title: Просто о сложном. Любит ли он вас?
programme.desc: Если хотите проверить, любит ли вас молодой человек, скажите ему, что до свадьбы у вас не будет секса. Если он вас любит, то согласится на такие условия. Почему? Что такое настоящая любовь, как она проявляется? Ведущий: Антон Бойков, священнослужитель

programme.title: Пит Стоп. Экстремальный спорт: подвиг или глупость?
programme.desc: Почему молодым людям нравятся экстремальные виды спорта? Зачем нам острые ощущения, почему мы хотим рисковать? Стоит ли участвовать в таких видах спорта ради ощущений? Как вера в Бога сочетается с участием в опасных видах спорта? Ведущий: Сергей Парфенов, Наталья Булатова, Богдан Павлюк, Надежда Малышева

programme.title: Жизнь с Богом. Как на земле жить вечно?
programme.desc: Во второй главе книги пророка Даниила описана увлекательная история: вавилонский царь Навуходоносор видит сон. Он помнит, что сон был впечатляющим, но не может вспомнить его содержание. Вспомнить сон и истолковать его царь считает очень важным. Кто помогает ему в этом? О чём именно говорит этот удивительный сон? Почему он несёт глубокий духовный смысл? Ведущий: Роман Кисаков, священнослужитель, молодежный лидер

programme.desc: Ведущий: Наталья Гончарова, Гость: Сергей Парфенов (гитара), Юрий Тараканов (ударные), Илья Никитин (синтезатор)

programme.title: Возрождение. Богатство лишения
programme.desc: Мы живем в обществе потребления. Материальные блага, богатство, успех – на это нацелены сегодня люди. Христианство же учит нас больше делиться, чем приобретать. Бог не желает, чтобы мы были бедными, терпели убытки, но Он хочет, чтобы мы не были привязаны к материальным ценностям, а на первое место ставили отношения с Богом. Что мы обретаем, отказываясь от блага ради ближних? Всегда ли бедность – показатель духовности? Ведущий: Олег Харламов, священнослужитель

programme.title: Контрасты души. Страхи и фобии: не дай себя запугать
programme.desc: Теми или иными страхами или фобиями страдает большинство людей, начиная от страха пауков и заканчивая страхом летать на самолетах. Может ли страх быть полезным и со всяким ли страхом нужно бороться? Как не оказаться в роли жертвы? Хочет ли Господь, чтобы мы чего-то боялись? Практические советы, касающиеся наших страхов, дает психолог-консультант Василий Половинко. Ведущий: Игорь Кириченко, Гость: Василий Половинко, психолог-консультант, священнослужитель

programme.title: В гостях у ТРК «Три Ангела». С Богом все иначе: не чего я хочу
programme.desc: Вадим Кочкарев вырос в интеллигентной, но неверующей семье. Только бабушка, исполняя церковные обряды, говорила: «Так Боженьке угодно». Эта фраза и положила начало его пути к Богу, пути, который провел его от собственных желаний к желаниям Божьим. Ведущий: Анна Богатская, Гость: Вадим Кочкарев, священнослужитель, магистр богословия

programme.title: Реальный Бог. Как Бог помог свекрови
programme.desc: Господь – Творец Вселенной. Он может открывать знания, которые нам недоступны. Евгению вдохновил молитвенный опыт своей свекрови, которой Бог помог найти ответ на важный для нее вопрос. Ведущий: Евгения Стефанив

programme.desc: Как общаться в семье без ссор и конфликтов? Как решать сложные вопросы и понимать друг друга? Когда лучше молчать, а когда нужно говорить? Нужно ли сохранять молчание, если ты видишь, что супруг поступает неправильно? Ведущий: Виталий Олийник, руководитель Центра духовного просвещения

programme.title: Принято считать. Четыре принципа самости
programme.desc: Самость – это понятие, которое относится к индивидуальности и уникальности каждого человека. Это то, что делает нас неповторимыми и отличными от других людей. Самость включает в себя не только физические характеристики и черты личности, но и убеждения, ценности, интересы и мечты. Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Айгуль Иншакова, психолог

programme.title: Загадки древних рукописей. Тайна Иисуса и Марии и Евангелие от Филиппа
programme.desc: Библия была написана на древнееврейском, арамейском и греческом языках, а затем была переведена на другие языки. Что отличает каноническую Библию от других видов Библии? Почему многие книги туда не вошли? Одним из спорных моментов, который поднимают читатели апокрифов – это отношения Марии и Иисуса Христа. Существует много мифов по этому вопросу. Однако стоит ли им верить? Где истина? Ведущий: Олег Габрусевич, историк, богослов, Гость: Александр Богданенков, филолог, литературовед, богослов

programme.title: Познавая истину. Быть святым без Бога?
programme.desc: Можно ли стать без Бога святым? Некоторые люди могут улучшить свою жизнь, но могут ли они изменить ее полностью? Что значит жить по духу и жить по плоти? Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, священнослужитель

programme.desc: Что скрывается за деньгами? Как сочетаются деньги и вера? Почему в мире есть бедные и богатые люди? Проблема богатого не в деньгах, а в том, как он их получает. В стремлении приобретать человек теряет совесть Ведущий: Мария Мараханова, Гость: Михаил Долженко, священнослужитель

programme.title: Веселая школа здоровья. Гендерное воспитание дошкольников
programme.desc: Многие люди живут по принципу: «Все лучшее детям». Что же нужно ребенку для счастья? Может быть это новый айфон, необычное лего, кукольный домик, популярные игрушки? Вовсе нет. Главное для ребенка – внимание родителей. Счастье для ребенка – это мама и папа. Семья – главный фактор в гендерном воспитании детей, где папа является образцом мужского поведения, а мама – женского поведения. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Татьяна Малышева, Гость: Самуил Баринов, Настя Жукова

programme.title: Лица времени. Остров надежды (полный фильм)
programme.desc: Рассказ о региональной общественной организации «Христианская Ассоциация служения осужденным». Многие освободившиеся заключенные находят здесь приют и заботу. Сотрудники Ассоциации помогают им изменить жизнь. Многие из тех, кто находит здесь приют, создают семьи. Председатель организации – Николай Либенко. Он – архитектор и писатель. Более 30-ти лет Николай Назарович помогает бывшим заключенным. В этом служении он нашел свое призвание. В Ассоциацию за помощью может обратиться любой человек, когда-либо бывший в заключении. Ведущий: Николай Назарович Либенко, председатель Тульской региональной общественной организации «Христианская Ассоциация служения осужденным»

programme.title: Благословения на каждый день. Везет ли верующему? (лето)
programme.desc: Франо Селак из Хорватии – один из самых удачливых людей в мире. Ему несколько раз удавалось избежать смерти. Кроме того, ему посчастливилось выиграть в лотерею большую сумму денег. Но даже этот везучий человек не так удачлив, как те, кто верит в Бога. Каждый, кто верит в Бога, получает все благословения неба. Ведущий: Андрей Довгель, священнослужитель

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey - Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alaska - the largest and at the same time most sparsely populated state in the USA. Only about 740,000 people live here. Often far away in small villages. Almost every village has its own airstrip. Aircrafts are one of the main means of transport in Alaska. Jamie Klaes is one of the many female pilots in the country.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Living conditions are harsh in the Australian outback, especially in William Creek. Only 17 people live here, and in summer even less - only two. There is a motel, a campsite, a pub and the only petrol station in a radius of hundreds of miles. The young bush pilot Hannah Jane Cash lives and works here.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Alia Twal is an enthusiastic pilot, globetrotter and adventurer. She is a first officer with the Jordanian airline Royal Jordanian and flies large passenger planes. She climbs the highest mountains in the world, dives with sharks or goes skydiving. Alia particularly enjoys travelling in her Jordanian homeland.

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: mareTV: Tenerife - The Queen of the Canaries
programme.desc: Tenerife is outstanding among the Canary Islands. If only because of the volcano Pico del Teide, which rises exactly 3.718 meters above sea level and is thus the highest mountain in Spain. But not only scenically Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands, stands out...

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii - The Island of Oahu
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won’t find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy’s Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. He fishes for his own needs and a few friends, he is not allowed to sell his catch.

programme.title: In the Heart of Scotland - By Train trough the Lowlands
programme.desc: The first part of this journey through Scotland begins in the colourful and vibrant capital, Edinburgh. It takes us through the rolling hills of the Scottish Lowlands, en route to the wild, picturesque east coast and Aberdeen. There are new and exciting views behind every bend: heath-covered hills with a magically purple glow, beautiful lakes and forests of the deepest shades of green. The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: mareTV: The white wilderness in Greenland's East
programme.desc: Fjords, glaciers and the highest mountains in the Arctic: East Greenland with its spectacular nature is one of the most sparsely populated regions on earth. The people here live in extreme isolation and depend on helicopter flights for their supplies. Despite harsh conditions, the inhabitants here lovingly maintain their traditions and enjoy their outdoor leisure time even at minus 20 degrees Celsius. The town of Tasiilaq is the "metropolis" with 4,000 inhabitants and offers a very special attraction: the only ski lift on the east coast. Thomas Mikaelsen, the lift attendant, is not to be envied for his job. The only 100 meter long lift comes from Switzerland and is already 20 years old. If Thomas gets the drag lift running at all, it often only lasts for an hour. Then the ski crazy's luck depends on his repair skills. The lift is the only frosty open-air pleasure. For Salo Kunuk his sled dogs are both pleasure and work. He is currently teaching his daughter Karla how to steer a dog sled, private driving lessons from her father, so to speak. Karla will need it, because in the eternal ice the sled is the only means of transportation.

programme.title: Lunenburg: Where the Land Meets the Sea
programme.desc: On the east coast of Canada, a place whose name sounds strangely familiar. The small town of Lunenburg, west of Halifax, was founded in 1753 by North German immigrants. Today, the idyllic town with its many wooden houses is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the 19th century, Lunenburg was one of the richest towns in the British Empire, becoming prosperous through fishing and shipbuilding. Glenn Rhodenizer's family traces back ten generations directly to German immigrants. And what the Rhodenizers primarily grow on their fields directly by the sea could hardly be more typical: it is white cabbage, which the farming family processes into sauerkraut. Sauerkraut can be found in every restaurant and supermarket in this area; it is the specialty of the region. The heritage of wooden boat building is successfully maintained by David Westergard. In his ancient shed, he is assembling a 20-meter schooner from four different types of local wood. Building wooden boats, he says, is like "slow food": sustainable, conscious, environmentally friendly, waste-free.

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord - From Sea to Sea
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands - Kihnu, Hiiumaa, Saaremaa & Co
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: The Provence coast - Marseille and the Côte Bleue
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: 45 Minuten Thüringen
programme.desc: In einer Koproduktion der lokalen TV-Sender in Thüringen bringt Moderator Mike Langer Politik ganz nah an die Menschen. In jeder Folge trifft er auf Politikakteure oder -beobachter aus dem Freistaat Thüringen und beleuchtet nicht nur die politischen Themen der Region, sondern auch die Persönlichkeiten hinter den Entscheidungen.Was bewegt die Menschen, die über Thüringens Zukunft entscheiden? Welche Geschichten und Erfahrungen prägen ihre Arbeit? ?45 Minuten Thüringen? liefert unterhaltsame und tiefgründige Einblicke in den politischen Alltag und zeigt dabei mitunter auch eine andere Seite der Politik. Freuen Sie sich auf offene Gespräche, aktuelle Analysen und persönliche Anekdoten ? für alle, die Thüringen und seine Macher besser verstehen wollen.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Teàrlaidh air chèilidh air Bing ach, chan eil e gu diofar dè an geama tha Bing son a chluich, chan eil Teàrlaidh deònach pàirt a ghabhail! Feumaidh Bing cothrom a thoirt do Theàrlaidh na geamaichean aige fhèin a mholadh. Charlie has come to visit but, unfortunately for Bing, his little friend doesn’t seem to want to play any of the games Bing likes. Flop explains to Bing that he should give Charlie the chance to suggest a game.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a chì Bing Pando anns a phàirc air an spèilebord aige, tha e fhèin gu mòr airson an aon rud fheuchainn. Ge-tà, chan eil an gnothach a cheart cho furasta ‘s a bha e an dùil! When Bing spots Pando zipping around the park on his skateboard, he is very keen to give it a go himself.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e? The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ peantadh diofar rudan, ach cha pheant Nìp còmhla riutha. Chan fhada gus a bheil iad uile còmhla ri Nìp, oir tha e tinn. Feumaidh iad uile smaoineachadh air dòigh airson cuidhteas fhaighinn dhe na spotan aca. Abney and Teal are painting all sorts of things, but Neep won't take part. Soon everyone joins in with Neep instead. They all need to think of something clever to help them with their spots.

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha sinn a' cluinntinn an-diugh cho romansach ’s a tha na capaill-mhara – mar a bhios iad a' tuiteam ann an gaol agus mar bhios iad a' dannsa còmhla. We hear how romantic seahorses are – how they fall in love and dance together.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Sreath ùr anns a bheil Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann òga agus a’ faighinn a-mach ciamar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluiche cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Florence agus a gearra-mhucan. ‘S e Buttercup is Bluebell na h-ainmean a th’ orra agus tha iad beag agus bòidheach. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh gearra-mhucan agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Florence, Buttercup is Bluebell a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh visits Florence and her gorgeous guinea pigs, Buttercup and Bluebell. We find out how to look after guinea pigs and all the lovely stuff Florence, Buttercup and Bluebell get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on how best to handle, train and feed pets.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ leughadh Sligeanach an aghaidh Geàrr: An Ath-rèis! Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Preston Rutt agus a dhealbhachadh le Ben Redlich. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Niall Iain Macdonald reads Sligeanach an aghaidh Geàrr: An Ath-rèis! by Preston Rutt, illustrated by Ben Redlich and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha a h-uile neach tinn – ach Dùd a-mhàin – agus feumar a bhith còir nuair tha Gumbal bochd. Ach saoil a-nis ciamar a thèid leotha uile? Everyone but Dùd is sick, and everyone must care when a Gumbal is ill. How will they all get on?

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Troig mì-fhoighidneach an-diugh - tha e searbh de bhith glacte sa mhagnat aig na Bògaisean ’s tha e dèanamh suas inntinn am magnat a ghoid. Chan eil an Rìgh toilichte idir ach tha Gubbo an dùil inneal a chruthachadh ‘son a’ mhagnait a ghluasad air ais. Troig is impatient today, he is fed up of being caught in the Bògaisean’s magnet once too often and he makes up his mind to steal it. The King is not at all happy but Gubbo intends to invent a machine to transport the magnet back.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Nuair a lorgas an tuathanach gu bheil pìoban ag aoidion, tha e a' cur fios air a' Bhòrd Uisge. Ach fiùs am measg nan duilgheadasan a tha seo, tha an treud a' faicinn cothrom airson beagan fealla-dha! When the farmer discovers he's sprung a leak, he calls the water board to come and fix the problem. The bored flock are thrilled by the opportunity to have some watery fun. When the workmen clock off, the party begins!

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha mèirleach shuiteas sa bhaile agus tha e a’ coimhead uabhasach coltach ri Pòl. Feumaidh Pòl agus a charaidean dòigh a lorg airson dearbhadh nach e Pòl a th’ ann idir. A sweet thief has been reported in Grimsby and the suspect looks strikingly like Dave. He and his friends must find a clever way to prove that he is not guilty.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl agus Anna a’ coimhead às dèidh sgòth bhochd a dh’fhuiling truailleadh. Tha iad a’ feuchainn ri tilleadh gu slàinte is ag ionnsachadh dhi mar a sgèitheas i. Dave and Anna nurse a poorly, polluted cloud back to health and teach it how to fly again.

programme.title: Dùbhlain DIY (Instructions Not Included)
programme.desc: Judges set two upcycling-themed challenges to the next three couples as they put their DIY skills to the test.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Neil Mitchison chats to Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean meets a storyteller to find out more about what makes a good tale.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: Ramsay cycles along part of the Crinan canal and heads to Kilmartin Glen. Ramsay air baidhseagail ri taobh Chanal Chrìonain agus ann an Gleann Chille Mhàrtainn.

programme.title: Na Sgiobairean mu Dheireadh/The Last Captains
programme.desc: An caladh na theine san t-seachdain mu dheireadh de sheusan a’ ghiomaich. Gun an còrr aige ri chall, tha Adam a’ cur a cheann an geall air an tùna. A fire rips through the harbour in the final week of lobster season. With little left to lose, Adam bets it all on tuna. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rudan Beaga Bòidheach/Life’s Little Things
programme.desc: Tha Niamh a’ socrachadh gus tlachd fhaighinn às na rudan beaga ann an nàdar. Niamh tries to slow down to appreciate the little things in nature.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ feuchainn air biadh à Iapan an-diugh. Tha Ruaraidh a’ dèanamh Wagyu Sukiyaki agus Bradan Teriyaki cuide ri Pak Choi agus nudailean. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh Coiridh Katsu ann an cruth biadh bhon taobh an iar agus an uairsin stèig Wagyu le glasraich uaine Oirthireach agus sliseagan ruis. The lads are inspired to cook Japanese dishes. Roddy creates a wagyu sukiyaki and a salmon teriyaki accompanied by pak choi and noodles. Uisdean rustles up a western-style katsu curry from scratch then cooks a waygu steak with oriental greens and rice chips. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sar Sgeoil
programme.desc: Cathy MacDonald on Catherine Carswell’s groundbreaking classic novel, set in Glasgow. Cathy Dhòmhnallach a-mach air an nobhail ùrail aig Catherine Carswell, ann an Glaschu.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu ruige Gleann Nibheis. Tha e a’ dol a shreap sgeir air a bheil ‘Storm’. Tha ‘Storm’ air a fùcadh am meadhan Poll Dubh, fear dheth na h-àiteachan is ainmeil ann an saoghal sreap. Bithidh e mar fhiachaibh air na sgilean a dh’ionnsaich e thar nam bliadhnaichean a chuir gu feum agus cuideachadh fhaighinn bho dheagh charaid. Coinneach MacFhraing travels to Glen Nevis to take on a climb called ‘Storm’, a classic test piece nestled in the middle of Polldubh, one of Scotland’s premier rock-climbing destinations. To succeed, he’ll need to put years of practise to the test and enlist the help of a good friend. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Hidden Lives
programme.desc: In this episode, presenter Vonny LeClerc delves into the fast and furious world of roller derby. The sport has exploded in popularity over the past decade with teams springing up all over Scotland. A cross between British bulldog and speedskating, it demands fitness, technique and skating skills, but in exchange for dedication there is an unrivalled feeling of community. Rediscovering her own passion for the sport, Vonny visits her old team in Edinburgh, the Auld Reekie Roller Girls, and trains with them for this first time in five years. She also witnesses the A-team snatch a last gasp victory against Nottingham’s Hell Fire Harlots, which propels them back into the European top twenty rankings. This grassroots DIY sport is a window into an alternative expression of femininity and sisterhood – one that is powerful, fearless and challenging.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: George Anderson and Brian Cunningham delve into the mailbox to tackle a host of viewers’ questions sent in from around the country. Even though we are well into the growing season, the pair start a major new project as they launch a makeover of a Beechgrove area known as the Crooked Garden. One of the first parts of that revamp is the creation of a stumpery, a growing technique based on an old tree and planted with a range of ferns. George has details on how to feed a cherry tree, Brian is back in the 8x6 greenhouse, and there is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden.

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: It's wildcard week, where we visit three escapes that don't fit into any of this year's categories, but that our industry panel decided had to be included. Kirsty and Helen from Perthshire rate former farm Monachyle Mhor in the Trossachs, House of Gods hotel in Edinburgh, and Glen Dye, a 15,000-acre private estate in Aberdeenshire.

programme.title: Martin Compston's Scottish Fling
programme.desc: Martin Compston and good friend Phil MacHugh travel up the west coast of Scotland on an adventure to discover the different ways people experience the great Scottish outdoors.

programme.title: Martin Compston's Scottish Fling

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: The Scottish Police Force are used to expecting the unexpected and every day contains the familiar element of surprise. This spoof 'blue light' documentary tails the Scot Squad as they check out what's inside a smoking van, unearth some potentially explosive evidence and learn how to go to the toilet with two broken arms. Newly promoted actual PC Ken Beattie now finds himself called upon to provide a character reference. Knights of the road Singh and McKirdy gallantly help out a hen do, and the Chief attempts international diplomacy by shouting loudly at a laptop.

programme.title: Edinburgh Unlocked
programme.desc: Unlock the best of the Edinburgh Festival with award-winning comedian Mark Nelson, bringing you the best comedy, music, cabaret and theatre from all over the world. programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Nigel Havers presides as members of the public with interesting items to sell come face to face with five dealers who bid against each other to try to bag themselves a bargain. Before facing the dealers, each seller has their item valued by auctioneer Simon Bower. Simon also gives them top tips on the history and key characteristics of their piece, so that when they enter the bidding room, they have all the information they need to try to haggle the best possible price from the dealers. All the dealers are spending their own money but have no idea what the sellers have brought in.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Like a record, baby! With three potential moneymakers picked up from Dunfermline Recycling Centre, JJ Chalmers gets the oven fired up trying to repurpose a record collection into something new. Upcycler Sarah's challenge is to give a dated bureau a bold new look, while blacksmith Kev has a heap of metal chair frames to rework into something spectacular.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill returns to Damson Farm in Bath and spends the day with owner Alison and a very special guest – Dame Mary Berry. Returning to the city where she grew up and went to school, Mary shares how the landscapes and countryside around Bath nurtured a lifelong love of gardening and the great outdoors. Together, they share practical gardening advice and celebrate the very best of summer, harvesting homegrown fruit, vegetables and flowers at their seasonal peak. Frances has advice on how to create a wild corner that's both beautiful and beneficial for wildlife while collecting seeds for future displays. Arit Anderson visits an inspiring urban edible garden in London, and there's a city gardener transforming a compact space into a thriving haven for wildlife. Toby Buckland shares clever ways to extend the growing season and make the most of summer harvests, and in Birmingham, there's a visit to a predominantly Punjabi allotment community where growing exceptional produce is intertwined with family, culture and tradition, creating plots that are as productive as they are beautiful.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Antiques experts Margie Cooper and Tim Medhurst close in on Gwynedd in their electric-converted, classic fire engine. In the beautiful north western corner of Wales, this stronghold of the Welsh language is home to fine seaside resorts like Llandudno, or ‘Beautiful Harbour of Peace’ as the town motto has it. But as they search the coast for collectibles, hoping to bag a few steals, Margie's surprised by a seagull after some steals of their own.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Programme in which experts uncover the various tricks of the property auction trade

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: While the red and blue teams hope to drive up profits by bargain-hunting in Newbury, Caroline Hawley visits a museum in Basingstoke that houses an impressive collection of Thornycroft vehicles. The earliest item in the collection is a steam wagon, a forerunner of the company’s first motor car, which was built in 1903. From the driver’s seat of this antique automobile, Caroline is amazed to learn that it cost £400 to make – the equivalent of ten years’ wages for the ordinary worker! It’s full throttle over at the antiques fair with our teams, retired firefighters Steve and Ken and best friends Tony and David. Stephanie Connell has her work cut out with the blue as she tries to cater for Steve’s love of ‘Asian and sparkly things’ and Ken’s love of ‘rusty metal’. Meanwhile, Raj Bisram and his reds are drawn to some quirky collectibles, including an Indian lunch box and an old shop till. Which items will they take to auction to be sold by auctioneer Thomas Forrester?

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Mehreen Baig, Clare Balding, Jamie Laing and Mike Wozniak take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games reusable coffee mug, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: Vernon Kay hosts the penultimate day of the week’s quiz, and today’s destination is Bristol. As ever, Paul Gorton leads the unreliable tour, dishing out facts and fibs like they’re going out of fashion. The celebrity contestants, EastEnders star Nitin Ganatra, the Rev Kate Bottley and Alex Gray, aka Apollo from Gladiators, all want to top the weekly leaderboard.

programme.title: The Great Rift: Africa's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Visible from space, Africa's Great Rift Valley runs three thousand miles from the Red Sea to the mouth of the Zambezi. It's a diverse terrain of erupting volcanoes, forest-clad mountains, spectacular valleys, rolling grasslands, huge lakes and mighty rivers, and is home to crocodiles, hippos, lions, elephants, flocks of flamingos and a diversity of indigenous peoples. Using state-of-the-art high-definition filming techniques, this series investigates the geological forces which shaped East Africa's Great Rift, and which make it one of the world's most wildlife-rich landscapes. The valley is the product of deep-seated geological forces which have spewed out a line of cloud-wreathed volcanoes stretching from Ethiopia to Tanzania. Their peaks provide a refuge for East Africa's most extraordinary wildlife, including newly discovered and previously unfilmed species which have evolved surprising survival strategies to cope with their challenging mountain environment.

programme.title: Spy in the Ocean
programme.desc: Spy creatures show the challenges of the ocean. From a baby whale in danger and marine iguanas battling storms, to a mantis shrimp’s knockout punch, the spies are never far from trouble.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show in which members of the public are invited to bring along their antiques for examination. Featuring a very tall longcase clock, a French automaton doll and a violin that astonishes its owner.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The show comes from the Bowes Museum at Barnard Castle in County Durham. The museum was purpose-built to house the collection of Josephine and John Bowes, and in the picture galleries, experts Paul Laidlaw and David Harper pick out some gems to value. They include illustrated books by Arthur Rackham and Edmund Dulac, and a carved dog's head. Presenter Paul Martin investigates the museum's latest conservation techniques.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Chris Bisson, Danielle Harold, Katharine Merry and Robert Webb take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games retro bag?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
programme.desc: Mum Rachel needs Bear’s help to repair her bond with 21-year-old daughter Venice. Rachel is desperate to build a loving and respectful relationship between them – one she feels she missed out on with her own mother. The pair have had a fractured history, and Rachel even had to give her daughter up for several years as a child while she battled addiction. They’re both adults now, but their fiery clashes have continued and are getting out of hand. In a bid to get them cooperating, Bear sets them a kayaking task. Can they keep calm and communicate to collect essential items for their night in the wild from out on the lake? With their camp set up for the night, psychologist Tara guides them through a stormy fireside chat – where tempers flare and emotions run high. Will their time in the wild help them create a better future together?

programme.title: European Athletics Championships
programme.desc: Two big field finals kick off the evening session on day four of the European Athletics Championships, with the women’s triple jump and women’s pole vault. The men’s decathlon is reaching the business end as well with the penultimate event, the javelin. Gabby Logan is joined in the studio by Jessica Ennis-Hill and Greg Rutherford with Steve Cram, Steve Backley, Andrew Cotter, Colin Jackson and Paula Radcliffe on commentary duty.

programme.title: The Big Deal with Steph McGovern
programme.desc: Seven pairs of aspiring art dealers compete to spot talent, negotiate deals and make a profit for the ultimate chance to win £50,000 worth of brilliant British art.

programme.title: A House Through Time
programme.desc: The house's first residents are the Rev William Fitzsimmons, an 18th-century Episcopal Church minister who is arrested for helping French prisoners escape from Edinburgh Castle; Francis and Isabella Ronaldson, the former a post office worker who spied on Glasgow weavers to detect signs of radicalism; and the Steell family, including John, a skilled craftsman but terrible businessman, and his son John Steell Junior, who became one of Edinburgh's finest sculptors.

programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: In 2024, the body of 65-year-old groundsman Brian Low is discovered on a country track in rural Aberfeldy, his beloved black labrador Millie by his side. Police assume that Brian has suffered a medical episode, but six days later, the post-mortem reveals the shocking truth - Brian has been shot dead. His former colleague and gamekeeper on the estate where he worked, David Campbell, now stands trial for his murder. With the site of the murder exposed to the elements for days, police are unable to forensically link anyone to the deceased. The prosecution builds a case against the accused around smaller, individual strands of circumstantial evidence while working to convince the jury that he is guilty beyond reasonable doubt.

programme.title: Corporate: Das Nichts
programme.desc: Als ein taktloser Tweet Hampton DeVilles Geschäft gefährdet, sollen Jake und Matt den Angestellten feuern, der ihn gepostet hat.

programme.title: Corporate: PowerPoint des Todes
programme.desc: Matt erstellt eine beeindruckende Präsentation, um der CIA in gutem Glauben Hampton DeVilles Waffenhandel anzupreisen. Währenddessen macht sich Jake die firmeninterne Whistleblower-App zunutze.

programme.title: Corporate: Der Schmerz des Lebens
programme.desc: Nach Jakes Operation schmeicheln sich seine Kollegen bei ihm ein, in der Hoffnung, dass er seine verschreibungspflichtigen Schmerzmittel mit ihnen teilt. Den an Schlafmangel leidenden Matt verfolgen Visionen von einem Geist.

programme.title: Corporate: Trademarq
programme.desc: Hampton DeVille schließt sich mit einem Straßenkünstler zusammen, der die Firmenzentrale beschädigt hat, um Anti-Konzern-Merchandise zu verkaufen und von den Gegnern zu profitieren.

programme.title: Corporate: Firmen-Klausur
programme.desc: Auf der Firmen-Klausur von Hampton DeVille bringen Business-Gurus Matt bei, wie man selbstsicherer wird. Jake findet Liebe bei einer Networking-Party.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Es ist schlammig und verrückt, es ist Takeshis Castle. Und es ist eine neue staffel Hundert Kandidaten stellen sich den rutschigen Trittsteinen und dem bekloppten Torwandrennen, bevor sie die Burg stürmen. Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert Kandidaten werden versuchen, Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Auf der schwingenden Hängebrücke müssen sie zeigen, ob sie die Leibgarde besiegen können. Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während brandneue Kandidaten sich auf den Weg zur Burg machen. Macht euch bereit für Ausrutscher, Stolperer und Stürze auf der Rutschwand und auf der Rollbahn. Werden sie es bis zum Finalspiel schaffen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Neue Kandidaten stellen sich dem schlammigen Fußballfieber und rutschen hin und her bei Malzeit, um sich einen Platz im Finalspiel auf der Burg zu sichern. Wer schafft es, und wer bleibt im Schlamm stecken? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Die Krieger sind bereit fürs epische Tauziehen, doch eine andere Gruppe versucht noch, zur Burg zu gelangen. Ihnen stehen das Frühstück und das Torwandrennen bevor. Wer schafft es zum Finalspiel? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während der General erneut hundert Kandidaten versammelt, die den Felsenkanal, das Frühstück und die Fallgrube überwinden müssen, bevor sie die Burg von Takeshi stürmen können. Hat einer von ihnen das Zeug dazu?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hunderte Kandidaten wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch kann sich einer von ihnen trotz des Bowlingspiels, der Grenzmauer und der Hängebrücke den Sieg holen? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert die hoffnungsvollen Versuche, die Burg zu erstürmen. Doch schafft es jemand, die rutschige Grenzmauer zu überwinden? Mehr Kandidaten, mehr Herausforderungen und sogar noch mehr Matsch zum Steckenbleiben.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kämpfer wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch wer kann den Fliegenpilz, den Felsenkanal und die Hängebrücke überwinden? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hier ist das Beste von Takeshi! Russel Kane präsentiert die Triumphe (und die lustigsten Patzer) in der Geschichte von Takeshi. Es gibt Sumo, die Hängebrücke und all das, was ihr nicht mehr vergessen könnt. Wer wird der König der Könige?

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Spielereien
programme.desc: Most Ridiculous, die abgedrehteste Clipshow von allen, ist zurück. Diesmal stehen Spiele und Freizeitaktivitäten im Fokus - von extremen Gesellschaftsspielen bis hin zu wahnwitzigen Wandertouren.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Teenager
programme.desc: Most Ridiculous, die verrückteste Clipshow im Fernsehen, ist zurück. Diesmal geht es um Teenager-Dramen. Wir zeigen alles - von wahnwitzigen Wutausbrüchen bis hin zu fatalen Fehlgriffen.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Dummheiten
programme.desc: Most Ridiculous, die schrägste Clipshow von allen, ist zurück. Diesmal stehen die größten Idioten aller Zeiten im Mittelpunkt: Wir huldigen den Königen und Königinnen der Dummköpfe.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Bauarbeiter
programme.desc: Warum eine Abrissbirne benutzen, wenn man das Haus auch mit einem Jeep einreißen kann? Die verrücktesten Bauarbeiter kennen keine Probleme, sie kennen nur Lösungen.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Babys
programme.desc: Die Kleinen geben ja sooo viel zurück. Für Eltern, die diesen Satz schon lang nicht mehr hören können, bietet diese Episode von Most Ridiculous die Möglichkeit, der Redewendung eine neue Chance zu geben.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Freunde
programme.desc: Echte Freunde sind diejenigen, die sehen, dass wir im Begriff sind, eine riesen Dummheit zu begehen - und trotzdem mitmachen.

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Sportler
programme.desc: 'Die verrücktesten Sportler'. Frei nach diesem berühmten Sprichwort, geht es bei dieser Episode in die wundervolle Welt des Sports, um die witzigsten Sportpannen jeglicher Kategorie zu präsentieren, die jemals bildlich festgehalten wurde

programme.title: Most Ridiculous: Die verrücktesten Hochzeiten
programme.desc: In dieser Episode von 'Most Ridiculous' erklingen die Hochzeitsglocken, auf dass unseren Pannenkandidaten dieser Tag auf ewig in Erinnerung bleiben soll.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Katzenallergie / Für eine Hand voll Staub
programme.sub-title: Katzenallergie / Für eine Hand voll Staub
programme.desc: Ren leidet an einer schrecklichen Allergie. Noch ahnt er nicht, dass er auf seinen besten Freund Stimpy allergisch reagiert. // Ren und Stimpy verlassen das Land, weil es plötzlich regnet.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Stets zu Diensten / Hund des Jahres
programme.sub-title: Stets zu Diensten / Hund des Jahres
programme.desc: Ren und Stimpy werden Hotelpagen und müssen verhindern, dass jemand herausfindet, wer in der obersten Etage wohnt. // Ren bereitet sich auf das jährliche Dog Lodge Meeting vor und Stimpy möchte unbedingt mitkommen.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Schulfreunde / Rens Dinnerparty
programme.desc: Ren bekommt überraschend Besuch eines alten Schulfreundes aus der Hundeschule - doch der führt jetzt ein bürgerliches Leben mit `ner Katze... // Ren Höek erläutert die richtige Etikette für eine stilvolle Dinner-Party.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Sunny und ich / Rens letzte Versuchung
programme.sub-title: Sunny und ich / Rens letzte Versuchung
programme.desc: Stimpy großes Idol Sammy Mantis Jr. tritt im Einkaufszentrum für eine Autogrammstunde auf. Doch das Gedränge ist leider groß... // Ren macht eine Nahtod-Erfahrung und lebt fortan tugendhaft.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Stimpys Haustier / Das Renhirn
programme.desc: Stimpy wird übermäßig abergläubisch. Er fängt an, ganz nach seinem Aberglauben zu leben, während Ren überhaupt nichts davon hält. // Ren und Stimpy reisen in ein neues, unbekanntes Land.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Fröhliche Yaknachten
programme.desc: Stimpy freut sich wie ein Schneekönig auf Yaknachten - bestimmt wird Ren ihm den heiß begehrten Tretroller schenken! Dumm nur, dass der egoistische Ren rein gar nichts vom Fest der Liebe hält.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Stimpys großer Tag
programme.desc: Nachdem er einen Wettbewerb bei "Gritty Kitty-Katzenstreu" gewonnen hat, verläßt Stimpy Ren, um ein Hollywood-Star in der Muddy Matschhüpfer Show zu werden.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Robin Höek / Schwester Stimpy
programme.desc: Robin Höek:Ren träumt, er wäre "Robin Höek", der tapfere Kämpfer, der das Geld der Reichen klaut.Schwester Stimpy:Als Ren krank wird, bietet sich Stimpy an, ihn rund um die Uhr zu betreuen, damit er schnell wieder gesund wird.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Weltraumkoller / Von Mäusen und Menschen
programme.desc: Weltraumkoller:Commander Höek und Kadett Stimpy, befinden sich auf einer Mission im Weltall. Doch Ren wird vom Weltraumkoller befallen.Von Mäusen und Menschen:Abgebrannt und hungrig beschließen Ren und Stimpy, daß sie sich Jobs suchen müssen.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: 2026 WORLD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE CONFERENCE SPECIAL | China’s Vision for AI Development and Global Governance
programme.desc: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) will conclude on 20th July in Shanghai. Join CGTN Biztalk on July 20 as it invites conference participants, industry observers and researchers to discuss the outcomes of the conference, and look into how China leverages WAIC as a premier industrial platform to foster dialogue, bridge divides, and promote shared governance.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc: Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy. We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations. One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays. At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward. In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Policy push brings smart homes into everyday life
programme.desc: China has expanded and upgraded its dual-new policy package, marking the first-ever inclusion of smart home products in central government consumption subsidies. CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores the Beijing Premium Housing Tech Expo, testing out smart home systems with voice control and automatic sensory adjustment. She also visits offline Suning stores, speaking with outlet managers and customers to uncover how smart home solutions are gaining mainstream traction, entering ordinary households, and driving the upgrade of China’s manufacturing industry.

programme.title: Behind CXMT IPO and China’s chip roadmap
programme.desc: As CXMT makes its market debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, the listing is drawing attention far beyond the trading floor. As China's top DRAM producer, CXMT sits at the center of the country's push to strengthen its semiconductor capabilities and build a more resilient technology ecosystem. What does the IPO mean for investors, the capital market, and the future of the global memory-chip industry? Join us on BizTalk as we explore market forces, policy priorities and the roadmap to technology self-reliance behind the landmark listing.

programme.title: Cheers: Carlas Traummann
programme.desc: Carla hat eine Kontaktanzeige aufgegeben. Ihre Freunde im Cheers antworten auf die Anzeige im Namen eines unbekannten Traummannes. Carla verliebt sich in ihn schon auf dem Papier.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebe deinen Nachbarn...
programme.desc: Norm und seine Ehefrau sind endlich mal ausgegangen. Sie waren mit den Nachbarn tanzen. Das war so nett, dass die Nachbarsfrau glaubt, ihr Mann hätte ein Verhältnis mit Vera. Sie kann Norm überzeugen, dass ein Privatdetektiv die beiden überwachen soll.

programme.title: Cheers: Rivalen der Bowlingbahn
programme.desc: Das Team vom Cheers hat gegen eine andere Kneipe ein Baseballspiel verloren. Der Besitzer der Konkurrenzbar bietet Revanche in einer beliebigen Sportart nach Wahl an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der verlorene Vater
programme.desc: Sam hat wieder einmal eine neue Flamme, Claudia. Sie ist hübsch, witzig und gebildet. Auch Diane freundet sich mit ihr an. Claudia überredet Sam, Diane mit zum Essen zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Don Juans Vorlesung
programme.desc: Diane soll für die Uni eine Arbeit zum Thema ,,Menschliche Sexualität" schreiben. Dafür nimmt sie sich Sam als Beispiel. Aus ihrer eigenen Erfahrung entsteht eine Fallstudie über einen notorischen Aufreißer und Don Juan. Sam ist davon begeistert.

programme.title: Cheers: Woodys Wette
programme.desc: Sam verspricht Barkeeper Woody, für ihn eine 1000 Dollar-Wette beim Buchmacher zu plazieren. Tatsächlich bringt die Wette 10.000 Dollar Gewinn ein. Das Peinliche ist nur: Sam hat gar nicht erst gesetzt.

programme.title: Cheers: Das letzte Hemd
programme.desc: Im Fernsehen werden gebrauchte Sachen von Prominenten für einen guten Zweck versteigert. Sam steuert sein Baseballtrikot der Boston Red Sox bei. Er ist sicher, dass es weggehen wird wie die warmen Semmeln. Doch das Ding erweist sich als Ladenhüter.

programme.title: Cheers: Kleine Streiche erhalten die Freundschaft
programme.desc: Im Cheers treibt sich seit einiger Zeit ein mysteriöser Mann herum: Er sitzt den ganzen Tag nur da und beobachtet die Leute. Langam werden alle unruhig. Ist der Fremde gar ein Spitzel?

programme.title: Cheers: Das Dreieck der Beklagenswerten
programme.desc: Dianes Ex-Verlobter Frasier verkommt immer mehr. Um ihm zu helfen, denken sich Sam und Diane etwas aus: Sam soll Frasier vorspielen, er leide unter Depressionen. So kann Frasier sein Selbstvertrauen als Seelenarzt wiedererlangen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Postbotenball
programme.desc: Cliff Postbote des Jahres. Beim großen Postbotenball soll er seine Auszechnung erhalten. Dazu braucht er eine passende weibliche Begleitung. In seiner Verzweiflung überredet er Clara. Die lässt sich den kleinen Gefallen aber einiges kosten.

programme.title: Cheers: Was Süßes für Frasier!
programme.desc: Frasier kann bei den Frauen einfach nicht landen. Sam und seine Stammgäste werden wieder einmal Zeuge einer derben Abfuhr für den Armen. Sie beschließen, ihm zu helfen. Eine Ehemalige von Sam wird ins Cheers bestellt und mit Frasier bekanntgemacht.

programme.title: Cheers: Mit der Frau vom Chef
programme.desc: Norm soll befördert werden. Für den Posten gibt es einen weiteren Anwärter. Dieser hat allerdings ein Verhältnis mit der Frau vom Chef. Norm überlegt, dieses Wissen für sich zu nutzen. Aber die Cheers-Mannschaft appelliert an seine Anständigkeit.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam Malone wird niemals alt!
programme.desc: Sams Freundinnen werden immer jünger. Er will damit allen beweisen, wie fitt er noch ist. Deshalb geht er auch mit Woody zum Sport. Dabei verletzt er sich. Heimlich begibt er sich in ein Krankenhaus. Dort baggert er pausenlos die Schwestern an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der letzte Tango
programme.desc: Carla ist aufgeregt: Die Showtruppe, bei der sie früher mit Nick getanzt hat, veranstaltet ein Tanzturnier. Alle ehemaligen Mitglieder sind eingeladen. Den Siegern winken 500 Dollar und eine Reise nach Hawaii. Nick ist bereit, mit ihr dorthin zu gehen.

programme.title: Cheers: Geständnisse im Cockpit
programme.desc: Jack, ein alter Verehrer von Diane, taucht im Cheers auf. Diane hatte ihn in Europa kennengelernt, nachdem die Affäre mit Frasier beendet war. Nun ist Jack enttäuscht: Er findet, Diane sei langweilig und fade geworden.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein Abend in der Oper
programme.desc: Diane ist traurig: Sie hat das Gefühl, nicht so recht zum Cheers zu gehören. Frasier schlägt vor, ihr mal wieder einen schönen Abend zu bereiten. Er organisiert einen Opernbesuch. Diane ist ganz gerührt.

programme.title: Cheers: Drei sind einer zuviel
programme.desc: Sam kommt auf die Idee, das Cheers zu managen und den Hausherrn zu spielen. Als Ersatz für sich stellt er einen neuen Barkeeper namens Ken ein. Leider läuft der Laden nicht so, wie Sam sich das vorgestellt hat.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam und die Stadträtin
programme.desc: Im Cheers ist Kommunalwahlkampf angesagt. Da taucht die Stadträtin Janet auf. Sam verliebt sich in sie. Diane, Wahlkampfhelferin für Janets politischen Gegner James Fleener, befürchtet, dass Janet Sam nur ausnutzt und nach der Wahl fallen lässt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Lauscherin an der Bar
programme.desc: Norm im Stress: Seine Schwägerin ist zu Besuch. Die flotte Dame tanzt ihm dauernd leicht bekleidet vor der Nase herum. Diane wird zufällig Ohrenzeugin ein Gespräches zwischen Sam und seiner Freundin, der Stadträtin Janet Eldridge.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Pressekonferenz
programme.desc: Sam ist noch immer mit der Stadträtin Janet zusammen. Sie will, dass er sie heiratet. Diane bekommt dieses Gespräch mit. Sie taucht bei einer Pressekonferenz auf, die Janet und Sam zusammen geben. Diane bringt die beiden mit ihren Fragen zur Verzweiflung.

programme.title: Cheers: Frag nochmal, Sam!
programme.desc: Sam macht Diane am Telefon einen Heiratsantrag. Sie ist entzückt, verlangt aber, dass Sam ihr den Antrag in angemessener Umgebung noch einmal macht. Sam kauft Champagner und mietet ein Segelboot. An Bord fragt er sie erneut. Diane sagt nein.

programme.title: Cheers: Salz in der Luft
programme.desc: Diane glaubt immer noch, dass Sam und sie irgendwann heiraten werden. Sam ist da ganz anderer Ansicht. Er will mit der hübschen Rhonda ein Wochenende am Meer verbringen.

programme.title: Cheers: Esther und Fitz
programme.desc: Seit einiger Zeit taucht im Cheers regelmäßig ein Mann auf, der für alle Gäste Drinks spendiert. Cliff findet heraus, dass der ältere Herr stinkreich ist. Daraufhin kommt ihm der glorreiche Gedanke, den Fremden mit seiner Mutter Esther zu verkuppeln.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Talkshow
programme.desc: Frasier ist als Gast in eine Talkshow eingeladen worden. Er präsentiert sich vor seinem großen Auftritt stolz im Cheers. Als er aber erfährt, dass er mit Dr. Lilith Sternin, einer Exfreundin, diskutieren soll, will er schon absagen.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Nacht des Grauens
programme.desc: Carla sucht ein hübsches, bezahlbares Haus. Cliff gibt ihr einen heißen Tip. Carla ist begeistert und kauft das günstige Eigenheim sofort. Norm ist angesichts des niedrigen Preises misstrauisch.

programme.title: Cheers: Normans wunderbarer Waschsalon
programme.desc: Norm hat eine revolutionäre Geschäftsidee ausgebrütet: ein Waschsalon mit Solarium! Während man auf die Wäsche in der Trommel wartet, holt man sich die künstliche Urlaubsbräune. Leider dauert dieses Jahr der Sommer besonders lang.

programme.title: Cheers: Dinner For Two
programme.desc: Diane prahlt damit, dass sie mit einem Verehrer im schicksten Restaurant der Stadt zu Abend essen wird. Damit weckt sie Sams Neid. Dieser wird nun keinen Trick scheuen, um auch einen Tisch in diesem piekfeinen Lokal zu bekommen.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc: Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port. With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads. In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites. Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Shared Roots in Wrestling
programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Suqian
programme.desc: Suqian is a small city in Jiangsu Province, which may not be so famous nowadays. In history, there was a famous figure here: Xiang Yu! Suqian is of great significance to our presenter Megan. Although she grew up in the United States, Suqian is her hometown. This time, let's follow the presenter to have a look at the local customs of her hometown that she always misses.

programme.title: Shared Roots in Wrestling
programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.
