programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.

தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Grenouilles-Mutantes
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mauvais rêves
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fou du volant
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les yeux de la Chimère
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Quête spirituelle
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Retour à New York
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Chasse au serpent
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Rhinocéros et le Cochon
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Casey Jones combat le crime
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Vengeur toxique
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des Mutanimaux
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mon nom est Mondo Gecko
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le venin mortel
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Perdus dans le temps
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende des Yokaï
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque du Méga Shredder
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'herbe-barjot
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Piège puissance quatre
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'arène du carnage
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Bataille pour la Dimension X
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.desc: チビっ子恐竜のロッキーとビル、ティニーとマズが、恐竜界最強のギガントサウルスがさまよう危険な世界に飛び込んだ！恐怖と闘いながら力を合わせて仲間達が冒険に旅立つ。

programme.title: Tivi5（チビ・サンク） おはなしで聞くアフリカ JEUNESSE
programme.desc: 誰もが好きな物語。夢と想像力が広がる空間で、楽しんだり感動するだけでなく、豊かな学びの場でもある。コートジボワールにスポットを当てた物語を紹介する。

programme.title: Tivi5（チビ・サンク） キクワの愉快な仲間たち LES QUIQUOI
programme.desc: 6人のキクワの愉快な仲間たちは次々とやってくる問題を、絵の力を借りながら解決していく。ちょっぴり変わった方法で、超現実的な世界を創造するのが大好きな仲間たちだ。

programme.title: Tivi5（チビ・サンク） ロッキーとリリーのたまて箱！ JEUNESSE
programme.desc: 毎日スタジオのロッキーとリリーのもとに新しい箱が届く。中には何が入っているのだろう？様々なテーマに巡りあうきっかけとなる、アッと驚く意外なものが入っている。

programme.title: Tivi5（チビ・サンク） ドラジリオン DRAZILION
programme.desc: 謎めいた生き物たちがいる世界で、オリとファビオ達は、ヴィルマークのモンスター、ドラジリオンを探す旅にでた。グラッシュ船長にかけられた呪いを解き放つことが目的だ。

programme.title: JT ラジオカナダ LE TELEJOURNAL DE RADIO-CANADA
programme.desc: ラジオカナダがお届けするニュース。

programme.title: （字）まばゆい太陽（訳題） UN SI GRAND SOLEIL
programme.desc: モンペリエを舞台に、バスティード、エストレラ、サラマ、レヴィらを取り巻く家族の生活は刻々と変化していた。ロマンスあり事件あり、それぞれの運命が交錯する。

programme.title: （字）文化遺産を守るヒーローたち LES HEROS DU PATRIMOINE
programme.desc: 小さな一歩の大きな挑戦。アドリアン・ガヴァッツィがフランス国内を巡り、地域の文化遺産を守ろうと日々奮闘する人々と出会う。

programme.title: （字）犯罪はすぐそばに（訳題） LE CRIME LUI VA SI BIEN
programme.desc: そっくりさん？ ジョニー・アリディのそっくりさんがアメ車の運転席で遺体で発見される。この業界の問題や対立関係を解明すべく、調査に取り掛かるのだが。

programme.title: （字）ホテル・サイレンス（訳題） HOTEL SILENCE
programme.desc: 自殺を決意したジャンは、娘が自分の遺体を発見しないよう、戦争で荒廃した異国に旅立つ。現地で生き延びた人々の逞しさに触れ、ジャンは徐々に生きる希望を見出していく。

programme.title: フランス海外県ニュース OUTREMER.L'INFO
programme.desc: フランス海外県の最新ニュースをお届けする。

programme.title: 寓話と伝説 CONTES ET LEGENDES
programme.desc: ジョエル・ポメラが人間とロボットが共存する近未来を描き出す。AIの危険性や進歩を語るのではなく、思春期の自己形成と人工的に作られた人格というテーマを探る。

programme.title: フランス２ニュース LE JOURNAL DE FRANCE 2
programme.desc: フランス公共放送のひとつであるフランス２がお届けするニュース番組

programme.title: （字）ラムの大通り BOULEVARD DU RHUM
programme.desc: 禁酒法真っ盛りの1920年代、ラム酒の密売人コルネリウスはメキシコへ逃亡中。偶然見た映画でハリウッド女優に一目惚れした彼は、映画を追い求めカリブの海を駆け巡る。

programme.title: 地中海自然紀行 MAGAZINE
programme.desc: 司会ナタリー・シモンがプロヴァンス、アルプス、コートダジュールの国立公園や地域自然公園、保護区をめぐり、自然とともに暮らす人々を訪れる旅番組。

programme.title: （字）友だちと行く 新しい旅のかたち DOCUMENTAIRE
programme.desc: 責任を持ち、環境に配慮した方法で考えられた観光イニシアチブを見つけようと、友人2人が旅に出た。今まで経験したことのない文化的・人間的な体験を味わえる絶好の機会。
programme.category: ドキュメンタリー／教養

programme.title: 報道〜64 minutes 討論 64' DEBAT
programme.desc: 世界の今を解析するTV5MONDEの情報番組。ゲストを迎え、多角的な視点でテーマを掘り下げる。文化最新情報に重点を置き、週末には特別な構成で多彩な話題をお届け。

programme.title: ゲストを迎えて L'INVITE

In Marseille, Hugues Mbanda, a chef originally from Kinshasa, has a journey marked by exile and a passion for French gastronomy. Hugues also takes part in the Climat Libe Tour, an event raising awareness of sustainable and responsible food.

programme.title: Kulturplatz: Ein Abschied nach 40 Jahren und das kleinste Opernhaus Oberfrankens (Wh.)
programme.desc: Der Bratschist Martin Timphus war 40 Jahre lang bei den Bamberger Symphonikern dabei. Er geht nun in den wohlverdienten Ruhestand. Seit 1985 hat Timphus das Orchester nicht nur als herausragender Musiker geprägt, sondern auch durch sein vielfältiges Engagement. \nUND "Welcher Heidehase hat die schönste Sängerstimme?" Diese Frage wird jedes Jahr aufs Neue in einem besonderen Wettstreit geklärt - und dieses Jahr winkt eine ganz besondere Trophäe: die Hand der Tochter des Hasenkönigs Lamprecht des Siebenten. Was zunächst wie eine Parodie auf Wagners Die Meistersinger von Nürnberg klingt, ist der Sängerkrieg der Heidehasen. Das Bayreuther Operla holt den Kinderklassiker aus dem Äther der frühen Radiozeit nun auf die Bühne des Kleinen Festspielhauses in Bayreuth.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the old Trained Assassins crew are headed back to Montrose in pursuit of a big elk. The conditions are not favorable but the crew is sticking it out!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our members. We spent some time in camp with Ron Chandler. Ron Recently renewed his TTHA Membership in 2022 and was awarded a member hunt for 2023. We spend time reflecting on what hunting means to Ron and spending time in camp at G2 with hunters alike.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week our team visits The Rocky Creek Ranch with two long time supporters of TTHA, Blake Barnett and John Fink. The goal in this episode is white management, which is something both Blake and John are passionate about. Blake has been hunting many years but what takes place in this hunt is a first.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Avinon takes Blair off Naples for a variety of fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair tries for an upgrade off the coast of Naples.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out by himself out of Cape Canaveral and gets a surprise at the end.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: The first half Blair heads out with Greggor Dornau of Starbrite Solutions, then in the second half goes fishing with Capt. Bobby lane for bass.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green explores the 10,000 islands off the West Coast of Florida on his Sea-Doo while trying to catch fish after red tide. If the idea of camping off the grid, only eating what you catch, and discovering remains of thousand-year-old civilizations excites you, this is an episode you won't want to miss.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson set off to hunt the American Alligator in eastern Texas. A species that was placed on the endangered species list in the 1960s, their populations are now thriving. Kyle and Jeff have agreed to help remove some problem gators off private land owned by their friend Troy, but things get rowdy when Kyle loses a bet and has to swim with the very gators he is hunting.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to Alaska to target sockeye salmon. The beautiful color of these harvested fillets will blow your mind.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Maryland to bow-fish for an invasive, toothy fish called the snakehead. They learn how this fish, a native of Asia, made its way to the United States. They also learn from the locals, despite its appearance, it is one tasty fish.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts ends a two-year quest on a giant deer in Harris County, Georgia. Better yet, it's a great, big bow buck. What a hunt! Follow along as he finishes the story on an old whitetail.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The Road Trips crew is out hunting from Iowa down to Georgia! The guys are joined by Joel Burham of Whitetail Fit and Josh Sparks of MidWest Whitetail. The pre rut action is getting hot and Charlie Thomas puts down his hit list 10 pointer!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Ben McDonald heads back to Nebraska this time to freezing temp and snow. Ben is after a huge bodied buck that has started to show up on trail cameras. He is hoping the first time into the area is the charm as he bow hunts this Nebraska Giant Buck!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: After taking 2 great bucks in Nebraska, the Road Trips crew came back home to Georgia with Tyler and Rigsby taking bucks on back to back sits! Dash makes 3 Georgia bucks in 3 sits!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: It happens, especially once the rut rolls around. A Monster Buck named drops that Tyler Jordan had been hunting all season wonders over to the neighbors and is shot by hunter Wesley Tyus. Check out the story of Drops and how Tyler was able to be there for the recovery of this once in a lifetime buck.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken Letchworth set out on a new adventure, exploring food fishing and the great outdoors. This father son duo are making memories that will last a lifetime and will forever be etched in the digital world.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken head to South Texas in search of trophy-sized trout. Along the way they make a pitstop to gear up and custom-build a Texas wading rod.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: With human populations scattered through the landscape, human-wildlife conflict is a common occurrence in Borneo. Dan Cabela travels to the area to participate in an ambitious elephant collaring project, hoping to better understand how people and elephants can live harmoniously.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: A remnant of the last Ice Age, the musk ox is almost mythical in appearance. For the people who share the Barren Ground region of Canada with them, they are an integral part of their culture. Show host, Dan Cabela, participates in a scientific sampling project to monitor the - population's health, and get first-hand experience of the relationship between local people and this arctic icon.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: In this episode Mark is excited to return to famous Sam Rayburn to fish with one of the legends of bass fishing, Tommy Martin; they'll discuss and capture some information on Tommy's career on this trip for the episode. Also will note that Mark fished a Bassmaster Open on the lake back in the early 2000's. Another interesting tidbit is that Mark was actually on Sam Rayburn fishing when the space shuttle blew up; he actually heard the explosion and felt the rumble.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: John and a group of friends make an annual winter trip to catch smallmouth in the dead of KY wintertime on Dale Hollow Lake. Dale Hollow holds the world record smallmouth catch. Nick and Mark Stowe joined the group a few years back but the fishing was a bit tough. Nick and Mark joining again for this episode to try and catch some smallmouth on the famous "Floating Fly Technique".

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny meets up with Jeff Coffee of ZOE angling group to talk shop, tie flies and fish in one of the most biodiverse lakes in the country.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Het nieuwe begin - Milly hat sich zur Grenzwache versetzen lassen und fährt jetzt Kontrolle in der so genannten Außenwelt, in der Hoffnung, ihren Vater zu finden. Sie bittet ihren Patrouillenpartner Rein, einen alten Bekannten, um Unterstützung. Was Milly nicht weiß: Rein ist ein Informant von Regulator Simons... Hanna versucht, einem kranken kleinen Jungen zu helfen, dessen Eltern über einen zu niedrigen Score verfügen, um Anspruch auf angemessene medizinische Versorgung zu haben. Regulator Simons setzt derweil Alex unter Druck, Beweise für den Betrug ihrer Familie vorzulegen. Im Gegenzug würde ihr Score verbessert werden...

Ergänzt werden die Reportagen durch praktische Reisetipps und konkrete Anregungen für die eigene Planung. Doch während die Mädels ihre Handtücher ausbreiten, hat Mattis noch einen anderen Ort entdeckt: Bei den Bäumen am Wasser kann man super Steine flitschen lassen. Das findet Silje richtig uncool.

programme.title: Campsite
programme.desc: Endlich alleine - Episode 12 Siljes Schwester Emmi möchte allein im Wald zelten. Dass sie im Rollstuhl sitzt, ist für sie kein Hindernis. Während Silje ihr das Zelt aufbaut, taucht Max mit seinem Bruder Mattis auf - ebenfalls im Rollstuhl. Auch er will hier zelten. Die Stelle ist einfach perfekt! Aber schon bald entbrennt ein Streit zwischen den beiden. Da greift Mattis zu einem Trick.

programme.title: Campsite

Das zweite Kajak-Abenteuer startet mit gemischten Gefühlen: Während Niklas an den Paddelkünsten seiner Freunde fast verzweifelt, läuft es bei Leyla und Emma wie geschmiert. Und Kaja imponiert mit ihren Filetierkünsten.

Die Seilbrücke schwankt, und die andere Seite muss ohne Abrutschen erreicht werden. Werden es alle Abenteurer schaffen?

programme.title: Durch die Wildnis - Das Abenteuer Deines Lebens

Auch die heutige Herausforderung hat es in sich: Die Abenteurer müssen von einem hohen Felsen in ein Becken des Flusses springen. Das Wasser ist eiskalt. Werden es wirklich alle wagen?

programme.title: Von Kapstadt in die Kalahari - Südafrikas unbekannter Westen
programme.desc: Von Kapstadt in die Kalahari - Südafrikas unbekannter Westen - Die Reise geht durch Südafrikas Westen, vom Kap der Guten Hoffnung bis in die Kalahari an der Grenze zu Namibia und Botsuana. programme.title: Garten & Lecker

programme.title: Papageien, Palmen & Co.
programme.desc: Gourmet-Überraschung - Endlich ist es so weit: Die Otter Khali und Murphy können ihr neues Gehege beziehen. . Aber werden sich die beiden quirligen Tierchen im "Otterparadies" auch wohlfühlen? Kurator Matthias ist von seiner Brasilienreise zurück und hat für die Vögel im Park etwas mitgebracht: Originalfutter aus der Heimat der Vögel. Er ist gespannt, wie die prächtigen blauen Hyazinth-Aras und die Lear-Aras im Park auf die brasilianischen Nüsse reagieren - die für ihre wilden Verwandten wahre Leckerbissen sind.

programme.title: Papageien, Palmen & Co.
programme.desc: Keine leichte Aufgabe ... - Heute sollen die Flachlandgorillas gewogen werden. Die Tucane sollen sich an ein ganz besonderes Futter gewöhnen... dafür geben Biologe Rafael und Kurator Mathias alles...

programme.title: Pinguin, Löwe & Co.
programme.desc: Mongolen in Münster - 63. Mongolen in Münster Ganz besondere Pferde sind im Münsteraner Allwetterzoo untergebracht: Mongolenpferde. Zwei Zuchtstuten dieser seltenen Rasse, die vom Urpferd abstammt, sollen auf einem Gestüt gedeckt werden. Um ihren Transport vorzubereiten, kommt extra der mongolische Pferdeflüsterer Tomor nach Münster. Um die kleinen Geparden kümmern sich Tierärztin und Pfleger allein kümmern: Die drei Monate alten Raubkatzen müssen geimpft werden. Zwar sind die Jungtiere nicht viel größer als Hauskatzen, aber sie verhalten sich schon wie echte Raubtiere...

programme.title: Nashorn, Zebra & Co.
programme.desc: Ein Pinguin auf der Flucht - Ob sich die Eisbären Yowannah und Yogi in ihrer neuen Anlage wohlfühlen? Elefantenbulle Gadschendra bekommt Besuch von seinem persönlichen Trainer. Bei sommerlicher Hitze haben auch Braunbären Appetit auf eine kühle Erfrischung, da müssen sich die Tierpfleger etwas einfallen lassen. Warum ein Pinguin das Weite sucht, welchen Bart Eulen haben - diese und viele andere Geschichten aus dem Münchner Tierpark Hellabrunn sieht man in dieser Folge von "Nashorn, Zebra & Co.".

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Eine Leiche zum Kaffee - Blitzermarathon in Wolfratshausen. Hubert und Girwidz geht der Baulöwe Max Hofmann ins Netz. Über seinem Lenkrad zusammengebrochen, rast er in ihre mobile Radarfalle und kann nur noch tot geborgen werden. Erste Ergebnisse von Dr. Fuchs legen den Schluss nahe, dass Hofmann an einer noch unbekannten Krankheit gestorben sein könnte. Eindeutige Symptome und ein Afrikaaufenthalt sprechen dafür. Eine Drohnachricht auf seinem Handy lässt Hubert allerdings in eine andere Richtung ermitteln. Während er der Spur einer möglichen Vergiftung nachgeht, gerät Girwidz in Panik. Nach einer versuchten Mund-zu-Mund-Beatmung ist er sich absolut sicher, vom Opfer angesteckt worden zu sein.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Eine persönliche Angelegenheit - Sabine Kaiser will Feierabend machen, als sie Besuch von einem etwas aufdringlichem Herrn bekommt, den sie offenbar schon länger kennt. Das Gespräch ist Kaiser offensichtlich unangenehm, am Ende setzt sie den Mann vor die Tür. Als sie kurz darauf selbst das Revier verlassen will, wird sie von einem Maskierten überwältigt. Am nächsten Morgen suchen die Kollegen vergeblich nach ihrer Chefin. Die Beobachtung von Girwidz, der den Besucher noch hatte kommen sehen und eine Vorladung Sabine Kaisers als Zeugin vor Gericht, erhärten schließlich den Verdacht, dass die Revierleiterin entführt wurde.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: It is Danny's first day as State Vet and when he helps rescue some smuggled animals he feels he's making a difference. However, he discovers the role isn't going to be all plain sailing.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny's first big project as State Vet is a major animal translocation, and he is desperate to impress. Meanwhile, whilst Alice is out in the bush treating an injured zebra, she is stalked by lions. She makes it back to her jeep in time but is shaken up.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice is still suffering from a loss of nerve after her close shave with the lions and so Danny tries to help her overcome her problems – the Leopard's Den lions have produced their first cub and he needs Alice back in the saddle.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: In his role as State Vet, Danny works with wealthy conservationist, Anton Ziegler, to catch a group of leopard hunters. Ziegler is also buying a tiger from Vanessa, who struggling with her finances, desperately needs the money to ensure Mara's future.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Du Plessis has started a one man campaign of vandalism against the new neighbours at Mara; Peeters and the mining company. When Peeters catches him on CCTV, Du Plessis is fined and given a restraining order to keep him away from Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Du Plessis comes to meet Caroline's plane but he doesn't seem happy – he has seen that the mining company have already started building the road which threatens Leopard's Den.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family are making arrangements to leave Leopard's Den, all except Du Plessis who is steadfastly refusing to accept that he has lost his home. He won't use his share of the money from the sale of the land to buy somewhere else.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: The family have been squatting at Leopard's Den as they prepare to make their last stand to prevent the bulldozers from destroying their home. Du Plessis and Fatani bring elephants and a giraffe to dissuade the construction crew from moving in.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: After the devastating loss of Leopard's Den, the family are split across continents. Caroline, Liv and a heavily pregnant Alice are in the UK, while Danny and Du Plessis have remained in South Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny returns to South Africa with Caroline, Liv and Charlotte. They are all excited to be back and are looking forward to seeing their new home, Clearwater Farm.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny has been preparing his pitch for an Endangered Species Project. JLW, a pharmaceutical company, are looking to fund an environmental project and the family hope that this grant money will enable them to buy Leopard's Den and Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Ed release two cheetah brothers together, a symbol of their new partnership, but not all of the family are happy about this new start. Caroline is still furious at what she sees as Danny's betrayal of Du Plessis.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Grenzgänger – Spurensuche am ehemaligen Todesstreifen
programme.desc: Bis zum Mauerfall trennte und teilte ein Todesstreifen Deutschland. Zwei Autoren, einer aus dem Westen, der andere aus dem Osten, begeben sich auf Spurensuche – 30 Jahre nach dem Mauerfall.Mit der Grenzöffnung im Jahr 1989 lebten die Anwohner des Todesstreifens plötzlich mitten in Deutschland. Die 1400 Kilometer lange, früher schwer bewachte innerdeutsche Grenzlinie hieß nun. Niemcy. 2019. Dokumentation

programme.title: Leben an der deutsch-deutschen Grenze
programme.desc: 40 Jahre teilen Stacheldraht und Minen Deutschland in Ost und West – trennt der Todesstreifen der innerdeutschen Grenze das Land. Für viele Deutsche wird er zum Schicksal.Im Film erzählen sie ihre Erlebnisse: darunter Flüchtlinge und Grenzsoldaten – und zwei Frauen aus Magdeburg. Sie sind die ersten DDR-Bürger, die am 9. November 1989 über die geöffnete Grenze fahren – bei Helmstedt, bevor in Berlin die Mauer fällt.Für die Deutschen im westlichen. Niemcy. 2025. Dokumentation

programme.title: Jugend in der DDR – Träume hinter Mauern
programme.desc: Wie war es, im Osten aufzuwachsen? Wo setzte die DDR Grenzen, und wo konnten sich junge Menschen Freiräume erkämpfen? Die Reihe blickt mit Zeitzeugen zurück auf die Jugend in der DDR.Die zweite Folge beleuchtet das Leben Jugendlicher in der DDR nach dem Mauerbau 1961 bis 1976. Die Ost-Jugend will leben. Sie liebt denselben Rhythmus, der auch westdeutsche Teenager in die Tanzlokale lockt, ist inspiriert vom Sound der 1960er-Jahre.Jung sein in der DDR – wie fühlte sich das in den 1960er- und 1970er-Jahren an? Wie hat man als Heranwachsender in der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik gelebt? Verhielten sich die Teenager tatsächlich so systemkonform, wie der Arbeiter- und Bauernstaat seine Jugend gern gesehen hätte? Niemcy. 2021. Dokumentation

programme.title: Notruf Hafenkante – Getrieben
programme.desc: Einsatz für Franzi und Hans: Bei einer Rangelei wurde der Teenager Annalena mit einem Messer schwer verletzt. Ihre Freundin Britta bezeugt, dass ein alter Mann sie niedergestochen habe.Doch Franzi glaubt, dass Britta lügt. Bevor sie das Mädchen aber zu weiteren Details befragen kann, ist Britta verschwunden. Franzi ärgert sich am meisten über sich selbst. Ein Anfängerfehler, einen Zeugen nicht im Auge zu behalten.Und das gerade jetzt, nachdem sie erst so kurze Zeit wieder zurück im Dienst ist. Während Franzi und Hans sich darauf konzentrieren, den flüchtigen Täter und auch Britta zu finden, übernehmen Melanie und Mattes die Ermittlungen beim Einbruch in der Wohnung von Ellen Flügger. Diese lebt mit ihrem dementen Vater Thies Wildberger und ihrer Tochter Svenja zusammen. Geld wurde gestohlen, und außerdem sind ihre Tochter und ihr Vater verschwunden. Bald ist klar: Beide Fälle haben miteinander zu tun, und Thies Wildberger ist Opfer und Täter zugleich. Der demente Mann verwechselt häufig Personen in seinem Umfeld, findet sich nur schwer zurecht und fällt auch immer wieder durch aggressives Verhalten auf. Dabei wird er nicht nur zu einer Gefahr für sich selbst, sondern vor allem auch für seine Enkelin Svenja, die mehr und mehr die Kontrolle über ihren Großvater zu verlieren scheint. Niemcy. 2015. programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops – Das Wasser zum Glück
programme.desc: Natur-Ranger Bartholomäus Kolb wird im Klimmbach gefunden: nicht ertrunken, sondern ermordet. Verdächtig ist seine von ihm getrennt lebende Ehefrau Marion Kolb.Bartholomäus hatte sie mit einem rückdatierten Ehevertrag finanziell über den Tisch gezogen. Ist das tatsächlich das Mordmotiv? Im Rahmen ihrer Ermittlungen geraten weitere Verdächtige in den Fokus der Kommissare Stadler und Andresen.So hätte auch Manuel Kersch ein Mordmotiv gehabt, denn das Opfer hatte eine Affäre mit Kerschs Freundin. Dritter Verdächtiger ist Raffael Schmölzer. Mit ihm hatte Bartholomäus Kolb Streit um Geld. Laut Schmölzer ging es um die Provision Kolbs für eine Heilwasser-Quelle, die Schmölzer ein lukratives Einkommen beschert. Die Kommissare Stadler und Andresen finden heraus, dass Schmölzer nur eine bestimmte Wassermenge von der Quelle abfüllen darf. Liegt hier der wahre Grund für den Streit? Während die Kommissare ermitteln, hält Hilde Stadler ihren Mann zusätzlich auf Trab, da sie unbedingt das gute Heilwasser aus der Josephinen-Quelle probieren möchte. Niemcy. 2022. Serie

programme.title: SOKO Stuttgart – Schneewittchens Tod
programme.desc: In einem beschaulichen Ort nahe Stuttgart wird Tamara Balke – mit einem Apfel in der Hand – tot auf ihrer Streuobstwiese aufgefunden. Sie wurde mit einem chemischen Düngemittel vergiftet.Besteht Zusammenhang mit der bevorstehenden Apfelkönigin-Wahl, bei der Tamara als Favoritin gehandelt wurde? Um dem Verdacht nachzugehen, befragt die SOKO den benachbarten Apfelbauer Mirko Koslowski, der sich zum Apfelkönig wählen lassen wollte.Hat Koslowski aus Konkurrenz um diese wichtige Auszeichnung und das hohe Preisgeld gemordet? Oder hat die redselige Nachbarin Martha Weber, die die Tote gefunden hat, etwas mit dem Fall zu tun? Die Ermittler untersuchen weiter das Umfeld der getöteten Apfelbäuerin und stoßen auf den Mosterei-Besitzer Johannes Dräger. Dieser produziert exklusive Apfelsäfte und Spirituosen für eine große Feinkostkette und hatte dafür bis vor Kurzem einen lukrativen Liefervertrag mit dem Opfer. Doch dann kam es zum Streit um eine vermeintliche chemische Verunreinigung der Äpfel. Musste Tamara deswegen sterben? Auch die Lebensmittelchemikerin Bianca Schubert scheint in den Apfelstreit verwickelt gewesen zu sein. Sie war für die unabhängige Qualitätskontrolle von Tamaras Ware verantwortlich und hat mit ihrem Gutachten Johannes Drägers Verdacht bestätigt. Ist hier alles mit rechten Dingen abgelaufen? Niemcy. 2024. Serie

programme.title: Hallo Deutschland Abenteuer Auswandern – Neuanfang in Namibia
programme.desc: Es ist ein Sehnsuchtsziel für Abenteuerlustige und Naturfans: Atemberaubende Landschaften, endlose Weiten und eine einzigartige Tierwelt prägen das Land im Südwesten Afrikas.Namibia war eine deutsche Kolonie, noch heute sind circa 20.000 der gut drei Millionen Bewohner deutschstämmig. Sie alle leben in einem der am dünnsten besiedelten Länder der Welt, bekannt für seine Wüsten – die Namib im Westen und die Kalahari im Osten.Dort, etwa 180 Kilometer südöstlich der Hauptstadt Windhuk, hat Svenja Külbs aus Limburg an der Lahn eine neue Heimat gefunden. Mit ihrem namibischen Mann und den Kindern lebt sie auf einer 10.000 Hektar großen Farm und züchtet Rinder und Schafe. Es ist ein Leben voller Herausforderungen, für das Svenja Freunde, Familie und ihren Job in Deutschland eingetauscht hat. Es brauche Einfallsreichtum und Biss, um dort zu bestehen, erzählt die gelernte Pferdewirtin, die ihr altes Leben manchmal vermisst. Dazu gehören auch lieb gewonnene Essgewohnheiten wie zum Beispiel europäischer Käse. Und so brachte Svenja sich selbst bei, Mozzarella und Feta herzustellen. Und sie schaffte es mit einem selbst kreierten Rezept in ein Kochbuch, das sogar in Deutschland vertrieben wird. Niemcy. 2025. Dokumentation

programme.title: Die Neue Zeit – 1. Nach dem Krieg
programme.desc: 1963 in New York: Der berühmte Architekt Walter Gropius trifft die feministische Journalistin Stine Branderup, die ihm vorwirft, die Frauen am staatlichen Bauhaus unterdrückt zu haben.Gropius, inzwischen 80 Jahre alt und seit 1944 amerikanischer Staatsbürger, blickt auf ein bewegtes und erfolgreiches Leben als Architekt zurück. Branderup aber interessiert sich dafür, warum die Frauen in die Weberei mussten und nicht Malerei studieren durften.Gropius wehrt sich gegen den Vorwurf der Diskriminierung und beginnt, ihr von den Anfangsjahren des Staatlichen Bauhauses in Weimar zu erzählen: Weimar ist nach dem verlorenen Krieg nicht nur der politische Nabel der neuen Republik, auch in der Kunst versucht man, neue Wege zu beschreiten. Die alten Lehrstuhlinhaber und mit ihnen das alt-ehrwürdige Weimarer Establishment sehen sich mit neuen und avantgardistischen Kollegen konfrontiert, die die Kunst dem nationalistischen und piefigen Milieu entreißen möchten. Unter den vielen neuen Studenten aus dem In- und Ausland ist auch die Rostocker Professorentochter Dörte Helm, die unter dem Geist des Bauhauses ihre bürgerlichen Normen abwirft und sich jeglichen Einschränkungen widersetzt. Gropius unterstützt sie dabei, der Leiter des obligatorischen Vorkurses, Johannes Itten, sieht in ihr hingegen ein zutiefst bürgerliches Mädchen, das allenfalls zu epigonalen Kopien imstande ist. Doch der asketischen Strenge Meister Ittens stehen spontane Feste gegenüber, gemeinsames Musizieren auf offener Straße und Nacktbaden in der Ilm. Die konservative Bürgerschaft ist schockiert und formiert sich zum Kampf.Sechs Folgen. Niemcy. 2019. Mehrteiler
